vendored.capability: Nature-style manuscript writing method and shared scientific-writing guidance
vendored.update_policy: detect upstream commits weekly; review diff, validate upstream contracts, refresh the pinned vendor snapshot and run ScholarFlow writing gates before activation
vendored.removal_procedure: remove the vendor snapshot and scholarflow-manuscript-writing Skill, remove its fixture and writing route, then verify no manuscript proposal path remains

packages.update_policy: detect registry update, review source diff, run canary and activate only after gates pass
packages.removal_procedure: remove the exact package from runtime policy and Pi settings, reinstall the managed graph and run the release gate

packages.update_policy: detect registry update, review source diff and MCP permission changes, run canary and activate only after gates pass
packages.removal_procedure: remove the exact package and MCP configuration from runtime policy and Pi settings, reinstall and run the release gate

packages.capability: generic durable memory and session recall
packages.update_policy: detect registry update, review memory schema and ownership changes, run migration and rollback canary before activation
packages.removal_procedure: export or archive the Hermes store, remove the package pin and configuration, reinstall and verify ScholarFlow truth remains independent

packages.capability: tool, path, shell, and MCP permissions
packages.update_policy: major versions require source and policy diff review plus the complete live permission release gate
packages.removal_procedure: restore the reviewed fallback permission policy, remove the package pin and extension configuration, then rerun security and live gates
